system.effect:
Prerequisites: Two Zacian and Zamazenta Major Gifts
Daily – Swift Action
Effect: You gain +1 CS to one stat of your choice, as well as either +2 to your Critical Hit range or 5 DR until the end of the Scene or until you Faint. In addition, until this effect ends, any enemies adjacent to you gain a -2 to Accuracy Rolls if making any attack that doesn’t include you as a target.
